blocks.tamil_translation: Rasulallah, should we go now, at night? Or may we stay the night and go in the morning?” they asked. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Do you not wish to spend tonight in one of the gardens of Jannah?” (Spending the night in the path of Allah Ta'ala is spending the night in a garden of Jannah.)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ: أَيُّ اْلاَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: اَلصَّلَاةُ لِوَقْتِهَا، وَبِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ، ثُمَّ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب وسمي النبي ﷺ الصلاة عملا، رقم:٧٥٣٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Mas'ud (RA) narrates, “A man asked Rasulullah ﷺ, “Which is the best of deeds?' The Prophet ﷺ replied, “Performing Salah at its proper time, treating one's parents well, and then striving in the path of Allah Ta'ala.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: ثَلَاثَةٌ كُلُّهُمْ ضَامِنٌ عَلَي اللهِ، إِنْ عَاشَ رُزِقَ وَكُفِيَ، وَإِنْ مَاتَ أَدْخَلَهُ اللهُ الْجَنَّةَ: مَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتَهُ فَسَلَّمَ فَهُوَ ضَامِنٌ عَلَي اللهِ، وَمَنْ خَرَجَ إِلَي الْمَسْجِدِ فَهُوَ ضَامِنٌ عَلَي اللهِ، وَمَنْ خَرَجَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ فَهُوَ ضَامِنٌ عَلَي اللهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Three people are under the responsibility of Allah: if they live, they will be given sustenance and helped in their affairs, and if they die, Allah Ta'ala will admit them into Jannah. The first of them is the one who says Salam on entering his home; the second, the one who goes to the masjid; the third, the one who has set out in the path of Allah Ta'ala.”
